{{Top}}
[[File:MoistureVaporator-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[GX-8 water vaporator/Legends|GX-8 water vaporator]]]]
{{Quote|What I really need is a droid that understands the binary language of moisture vaporators."<br />"Vaporators! Sir, my first job was programming binary loadlifters—very similar to your vaporators in most respects.|[[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''moisture vaporator''' was a relatively simple device used to harvest [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] humidity. It was ground-based and used on planets such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|These machines are responsible for gathering this planet's single most valuable resource: water.|A moisture farmer to a droid|<ref name="DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Dpiu.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A [[Patch-in droid/Legends|patch-in droid]]]]
Moisture vaporators were devices that allowed [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] to survive in harsh [[Desert/Legends|desert]] environments by drawing [[Water/Legends|water]] out of the surrounding [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> increasing its rate of condensation through chemical process, and typically channeling the solidified water into storage tanks to be dispensed.<ref name="SW66">[[Star Wars (1977) 66|''Star Wars'' (1977) 66]]</ref>

The device comprised any number of tall slender refrigerated pipes (usually one). When hot, moist air came into contact with one of the frigid tubes; the humidity immediately condensed into droplets of pure [[Water/Legends|water]] that ran down the tubes and into underground storage tanks.

A properly maintained moisture vaporator could usually collect enough water to sustain three average [[Human/Legends|Humans]], even on desert planets like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]; water could be collected from air with a moisture content of as little as 1.3%.<ref name="Star Wars Technical Journal">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal]]''</ref> Because of the delicate nature of the machines, regular maintenance was usually required.

[[Patch-in droid/Legends|Patch-in droids]] were often used as counterparts to the vaporators, as the droids translated the [[Binary/Legends|binary language]] the vaporators spoke, for the benefit of the operators.<ref name="VG8">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp08.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide — Chapter 8: Droids for Sale}}</ref>

Farmers called a moist and dark area under the vaporator that commonly housed [[Vaporator mushroom/Legends|vaporator mushrooms]] the mushroom patch.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|These vaporators, for instance--they take moisture directly from the atmosphere, chemically increase its rate of condensation--then channel the solidified water into storage tanks where it can be more easily dispensed.|Darial Anglethorn|<ref name="SW66" />}}
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] produced vaporators for use in its more arid outposts, such as [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] obtained several of these as part of a negotiated deal with a local tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Army]] deployed vaporators during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to help reduce the amount of potable water that had to be shipped on [[Transport/Legends|transports]].

The [[Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective/Legends|Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective]] existed to protect the planet's water supply. Together with the [[Bestine Chamber of Commerce]], they sometimes employed hunters to kill the wild creatures that damaged the vaporators.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies - mission terminals">{{GalaxiesAED}}&mdash;information from mission terminals</ref>

One Tatooine [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]], the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], had 63 separate [[GX-8 water vaporator/Legends|GX-8 water vaporators]] on property.

[[Darial Anglethorn]] utilized vaporators, similar to those at the Lars homestead, on [[Beheboth]].<ref name="SW66" />

==Behind the scenes==
After filming [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], the vaporators outside the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] were left there, and are still visited by tourists to [[Chott el Jerid|the Tunisian desert]].
